test_env_var_affects_flag: test the GTestEnvVarTest class verifies that environment variables affect corresponding Google Test flags
test_xml_output_file: test the XML_OUTPUT_FILE environment variable affects the output flag in Google Test
test_xml_output_file_override: test that GTEST_OUTPUT environment variable overrides XML_OUTPUT_FILE for output configuration
set_env_var: set or unset an environment variable in a copy of os.environ for isolated test execution
test_flag: test that a Google Test flag is affected by its corresponding GTEST_ environment variable and resets to default
